description: Source code implementing tree comparison, matching, and manipulation functions for a version control system, likely Git. Contains functions for scoring tree similarity, filling tree descriptions, and shifting trees based on their structure.

methods.name: score_missing
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty based on the file mode when a tree entry is missing.

methods.name: score_differs
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty when two tree entries differ.

methods.name: score_matches
methods.description: Calculates a score for matching tree entries, with special handling for directories and symbolic links.

methods.name: fill_tree_desc_strict
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and initializes a tree descriptor.

methods.name: base_name_entries_compare
methods.description: Compares two tree entries by their base name, mode, and path length.

methods.name: score_trees
methods.description: Compares two trees and returns a similarity score based on their entries.

methods.name: match_trees
methods.description: Recursively matches subtrees to find the best match score and path.

methods.name: splice_tree
methods.description: Replaces a subdirectory in a tree with another tree object.

methods.name: shift_tree
methods.description: Generates a tree object that is a shifted version of one tree to resemble another.

methods.name: shift_tree_by
methods.description: Shifts a tree by a specified prefix to match another tree, evaluating plausibility.
